events.text: A quiet corner in the market. The cashier is distracted. Your mind starts doing the math on risk versus reward.

choices.label: Try a small shoplift and disappear
choices.resultText: You act fast. Either you get away, or you find out the hard way.

choices.label: Walk out and buy something instead
choices.resultText: You choose the boring path. It still feels cleaner than adrenaline.

choices.label: Wait for a calmer moment next week
choices.resultText: You do not escalate today. The temptation stays, but you remain in control.

events.text: In a crowded street, you feel invisible. The temptation is not the theft - it is the feeling of being able to do it.

choices.label: Make a clean move while nobody notices
choices.resultText: Your fingers work. Your heart beats faster once you are done.

choices.label: Refuse it and keep your hands honest
choices.resultText: You feel relief. You keep your future open.

events.text: A website looks official enough. The offer is too good. Your smarter instincts notice the scam - then your greed argues back.

choices.label: Try committing fraud in a quick scheme
choices.resultText: You play the role convincingly... until luck has the final word.

choices.label: Use your knowledge to protect others
choices.resultText: You stay dangerous in a good way: your mind helps more than it harms.

choices.label: Report it and walk away
choices.resultText: You choose stability. The temptation fades once you do the right thing.

events.text: After thinking about crime for years, you finally feel ready. The hard part is deciding whether to stop halfway.

choices.label: Walk away and break the pattern
choices.resultText: You take control of your story. The future stops being a loop.

choices.label: Commit to another attempt
choices.resultText: The adrenaline calls you again. If you get caught, you will not have excuses.

events.text: Something goes wrong. Not necessarily jail - just the feeling that your actions will catch up to you one way or another.

choices.label: Make amends with honesty
choices.resultText: You stop hiding behind impulses. It makes your next decisions easier.

choices.label: Deny it and move on fast
choices.resultText: You avoid guilt for now, but the risk stays in your future.
